evidence_change: A new first-party public optimizer study closes execution evidence into persistent prompt/tool-boundary harness changes and later held-out evaluation under a fixed inner model, adding a direct S4 evidence family at the external non-canonical AHO boundary.
reason: The new study strengthens direct S4 evidence but remains a single external evolving-harness organization. non_claim: This delta does not deny the reported held-out gains, does not assign canonical ownership to AHO or the fixed inner model, and does not claim that a matched S4 primary can never exist.
